parts.name: boa-meter
parts.title: BoaMeter (gauge)
parts.description: Gauge chart: a progress snake chasing its own tail around a dashed track. At 100% it catches it and becomes a full ouroboros. This is called shipping.

parts.name: cobra-chart
parts.title: Cobra Chart (bar)
parts.description: Bar chart where every bar is a cobra rearing to the exact height of your KPI, hood flared. Grouped series, staggered rise-in. An unhinged homage to dither-kit.

parts.name: core
parts.title: slither-charts — Core
parts.description: Shared engine for slither-charts: the canvas snake painter (traveling-wave slither, species skins, blinking eyes, forked tongues), scales, contexts, and the grid/axes/legend/HissTip chrome. Installed automatically by every chart. Zero depen

parts.name: medusa-chart
parts.title: Medusa Chart (radial bars)
parts.description: Radial bar chart: snakes radiating from one center, each as long as its value, labels around the rim. An unhinged homage to dither-kit.

parts.name: nest-chart
parts.title: Nest Chart (scatter)
parts.description: Scatter plot where every point is a baby snake coiled up at its coordinates — bubble size makes the coil bigger. Hover a nest to wake one. An unhinged homage to dither-kit.

parts.name: ouroboros-chart
parts.title: Ouroboros Chart (pie)
parts.description: Pie chart as a ring of snakes, each politely biting the next one's tail — the circle that eats itself. Hover to make a slice rear up. An unhinged homage to dither-kit.

parts.name: slither-chart
parts.title: Slither Chart (line)
parts.description: Line chart where every series is a live snake slithering along the data, head resting on the latest value. Scrub tooltip with a crosshair mouse the snakes never catch. An unhinged homage to dither-kit.

parts.name: viperstick-chart
parts.title: Viperstick Chart (candlestick)

parts.name: worm
parts.title: Worm (sparkline)
parts.description: Sparkline. Legally a snake, spiritually a worm. Fits in a stat tile, points at your KPI, occasionally flicks its tongue at it. An unhinged homage to dither-kit.
